content:
**Test image observations:**
- Soybean leaf with dense, dark brown to reddish-brown angular spots concentrated toward the leaf tip
- Spots are small to medium sized, following vein boundaries (angular pattern)
- Orange-yellow chlorotic zone surrounding the heavily spotted area
- Spots appear quite dark/dense in the affected region

**Top candidates:** Septoria_brown_spot (angular red-brown spots with yellowing), Bacterial_Blight (angular spots with yellowish-green halos)

**Comparison with Septoria reference:** The reference shows angular, reddish-brown small spots on yellowing leaves — very consistent with the test image. The dense dark spots with surrounding chlorosis and angular shape following veins matches well.

Bacterial_Blight would show more water-soaked initial lesions with brighter yellowish-green halos. The test image shows darker, more mature lesions without the characteristic bright yellow-green halo of bacterial blight.
